BASS_FX third-party add-on notice

Notice Summary (not authoritative full license text)
====================================================

Current classification: GREEN
The current release is non-commercial, non-revenue end-user software and
uses the retained BASS_FX package without modifying the DLL. BASS_FX is a
third-party add-on and is not a component authored by Un4seen Developments.

Copyright: (: JOBnik! :) [Arthur Aminov, ISRAEL]

The package readme states that the BASS_FX library is free, permits free

remain authoritative. A future commercial or monetized release therefore
requires a fresh license review; it is not a current YELLOW condition.
